templates.template:
<xf:set var="$wutimeSnowIsMobile" value="{{ wutime_snowstorm_is_mobile() }}" />
<xf:if is="$xf.options.wutime_snowstorm_option_theme == 'Default'"> <xf:if is="$xf.options.wutime_snowstorm_show_mobile OR !$wutimeSnowIsMobile"> <xf:js addon="Wutime/SnowStorm" src="wutime/snowstorm/snowstorm.js" defer="true" min="1" />
<xf:js> {{$xf.options.wutime_snowstorm_js_customizations}} </xf:js> </xf:if> <xf:elseif is="$xf.options.wutime_snowstorm_option_theme == 'Snowflake'" /> <xf:if is="$xf.options.wutime_snowstorm_show_mobile_snowflake OR !$wutimeSnowIsMobile"> <xf:js> window.SnowflakeConfig = window.SnowflakeConfig || {}; {{$xf.options.wutime_snowstorm_js_customizations_snowflake}} </xf:js>
<xf:js addon="Wutime/SnowStorm" src="wutime/snowstorm/snowflake.js" defer="true" min="1" /> </xf:if> <xf:else /> <xf:if is="$xf.options.wutime_snowstorm_show_mobile_snow OR !$wutimeSnowIsMobile"> <xf:js addon="Wutime/SnowStorm" src="wutime/snowstorm/snow.js" defer="true" min="1" /> </xf:if> </xf:if>
